NAME:
   rancher create password-change-request - Change a local user's password

USAGE:
   rancher create password-change-request [options] <user>

OPTIONS:
   --current-password-stdin  read the current password from stdin: with --password-stdin, stdin holds two lines, line 1 the current password and line 2 the new password. Rancher requires it when you change your own password without permission to change every user's password; there is no --current-password flag because a flag value would be saved in shell history
   --help, -h                show help
   --password-stdin          read the new password from stdin (required; with --current-password-stdin, line 2 of stdin; there is no --password flag because a flag value would be saved in shell history; the server enforces a minimum length, 12 by default; a newline inside the password is refused)

GLOBAL OPTIONS:
   --allow-deprecated          allow writing to a deprecated resource
   --apply                     apply the change
   --color string              auto|always|never
   --config string, -c string  path to the config directory [$RANCHER_CLI_CONFIG_DIR]
   --debug                     print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
   --dry-run                   preview the changes without applying them
   --no-input                  never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
   --output string, -o string  table|wide|json|yaml|name|template=<go-template>
   --read-only                 refuse commands that make changes in this run; once set it cannot be turned off; local commands do not accept it
   --yes                       confirm a destructive change
